findings.claim: onsemi 10-K 將「自行開發 IC 的客戶」列為競爭來源之一（一般性風險揭露），未點名特定最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製。
findings.excerpt: Because some of our components include functionality that in some cases may be integrated into more complex ICs, we also face competition from manufacturers of ICs, ASICs and fully-customized ICs, as well as customers who develop their own IC products.

customer_second_source.note: 兩次搜尋未找到特定客戶導入 second source 或 in-house 的來源；僅有 10-K 一般性揭露。
